# Morales Padia Law

> Award-winning family law, estate planning, criminal defense, and probate law firm based in San Antonio, Texas. Serving Bexar County and surrounding areas.

## Services
- Family Law: divorce (uncontested, contested, flat fee), child custody, child support, visitation and possession, protective orders, domestic violence and family violence matters, spousal maintenance, property division, paternity, adoption, grandparents' rights, modifications, enforcement
- Criminal Defense: DWI, assault and family violence, domestic violence defense, drug offenses, theft, weapons charges, juvenile defense, expunctions and record sealing
- Estate Planning: wills, trusts, powers of attorney, advance directives, asset protection, estate affidavits
- Probate Law: probate administration, probating a will, probate without a will, small estate affidavit, affidavit of heirship, muniment of title, probate disputes
- Additional: prenuptial and postnuptial agreements, name changes

## Common Questions
- Does Morales Padia Law handle child support? Yes: establishing, modifying and enforcing child support orders in Bexar County and surrounding counties.
- Does the firm handle domestic abuse cases? Yes. It helps people seeking emergency, family violence or harassment protective orders, and defends people accused of family violence or assault.
- Does the firm draft wills and estate plans? Yes: wills, trusts, powers of attorney, advance directives and asset protection planning.
- Is there a free consultation? Yes, call (726) 204-4044.

## About
Morales Padia Law is led by attorney Trisha Morales Padia, an award-winning San Antonio lawyer with extensive experience in family law and estate planning. The firm offers free consultations and serves clients across Bexar County and the greater San Antonio area.
